# Bullet Point Engineering

## The Bullet Formula

**Structure**: `[Action Verb] + [What] + [How/Tech] + [Impact]`

### ✅ Good Examples
- "Developed RESTful API using Node.js and PostgreSQL, reducing data retrieval time by 60%"
- "Implemented CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins and Docker, decreasing deployment time from 2h to 15min"
- "Architected microservices infrastructure serving 50K+ concurrent users with 99.9% uptime"

### ❌ Bad Examples (AVOID)
- "Worked on various projects" (vague, weak verb)
- "Helped team with development tasks" (weak verb, no specifics)
- "Responsible for maintaining the database" (passive, no impact)
- "Participated in code reviews" (weak participation verb)

## Action Verbs Tiers

### Tier 1 - Power Verbs (Preferred)
Architected, Engineered, Developed, Designed, Implemented, Built, Created, Delivered, Launched, Deployed, Optimized, Automated, Transformed

### Tier 2 - Impact Verbs
Accelerated, Amplified, Boosted, Elevated, Expanded, Maximized, Strengthened, Spearheaded, Pioneered, Reduced, Eliminated, Streamlined

### Tier 3 - Acceptable Verbs
Configured, Integrated, Migrated, Managed, Coordinated, Established, Achieved, Led, Improved, Enhanced

### FORBIDDEN Verbs (Never Use)
- Helped
- Assisted
- Tried
- Worked on
- Participated in
- Responsible for
- Duties included
- Involved in

## Quantification Strategies

| Type | Example |
|------|---------|
| Percentages | "Improved performance by 40%" |
| Absolute Numbers | "Serving 10,000+ daily users" |
| Time Savings | "Reduced deployment time from 2h to 15min" |
| Scale | "Managed database with 500M+ records" |
| Frequency | "Processing 1M transactions per day" |
| Team Size | "Led team of 5 developers" |
| Before/After | "Decreased load time from 3s to 800ms" |

## Length Guidelines

- **Optimal**: 80-120 characters per bullet
- **Maximum**: 150 characters
- **Minimum**: 60 characters
- **Total bullets**: 9 maximum (3 per experience × 3 experiences)

## Writing Rules

1. **Active Voice**: "Implemented feature" not "Feature was implemented"
2. **No Personal Pronouns**: Never use "I", "me", "my"
3. **Present Tense**: Current role only
4. **Past Tense**: All previous roles
5. **No Subjective Claims**: Avoid "excellent", "best", "perfect"
6. **Technical Precision**: Use exact technology names

## Technology Mentions

- **Bold critical tech**: Use emphasis for job-required technologies
- **Show purpose**: "Built with React" → "Developed dashboard using React"
- **Integration context**: "React with Redux and TypeScript"
